name: CSO_CONTENT_AUTOSAVE
description: This table contains the autosave representation of an article while editing is in progress.  Three situations exist that will need to be handled by this table - new content, edited content, and translated content.  Depending on the situation, the DOCUMENT_ID and CONTENT_TEXT_ID columns may or may not contain valid values.  The CONTENT_AUTOSAVE_TYPE column will store an enumerated value to indicate what editing situation the autosave record represents.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: CONTENT_TEXT_ID
columns.description: This is the reference to content text record.

columns.name: CONTENT_AUTOSAVE_TYPE
columns.description: The type of content being saved, e.g. EDIT, TRANSLATE, CREATE.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: The reference to the content this article is based on.

columns.name: TITLE
columns.description: This is the title of the content being saved.

columns.name: CONTENT_CHANNEL_ID
columns.description: This is the reference to the content type of the article being saved.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was last modified.

columns.name: LOCALE_ID
columns.description: The locale associated with the current record.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the Party ID of the Fusion user associated with this record.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the User ID of the OKCS user who owns this record.  Since this column will only be used by OKCS, and NOT Fusion, it will never be populated in Fusion environments, hence no foreign key constraint or index will be defined for it.
